title: Counter service
caption: The owner said they were out of the swamp special.
blurb: A small alligator entered a bagel shop in Southport, North Carolina, through the back door and stood at the front counter. The owner called 911, and no one was hurt.
alt_text: An alligator at a bagel shop counter, with the owner holding a chair.

title: Cow convention
caption: The real cow had been saying for years that nobody would notice.
blurb: A basketball team in Frederick, Maryland, set a world record when 1,902 fans dressed as cows at their annual event. The previous record was set in Australia in 2014.
alt_text: A crowd in cow costumes, with a real cow in the front row wearing the same costume.

title: The raccoon memorial
caption: A quarter mile of traffic waited to view the memorial.
blurb: Two brothers on Bainbridge Island built a fourteen-foot animatronic raccoon as a Halloween decoration. The giant creature drew long lines of visiting cars and required internal maintenance through a rear access hatch.
alt_text: Two small raccoons gaze up at a giant mechanical raccoon with glowing eyes in a front yard.

title: Patient audience
caption: The pigs appreciated the thirty-two hours of preparation.
blurb: A record-breaking pumpkin weighing over three thousand pounds was carved into the heaviest jack-o-lantern ever in Salem, Massachusetts. After Halloween the decorated gourd was donated as feed for pigs.
alt_text: Two pigs watch from behind a fence as someone carves a gigantic jack-o-lantern.

title: Night scrub
caption: The neighborhood had started leaving them the filthier ones.
blurb: A couple in Brighton began cleaning grimy road signs and posting the process online as an ASMR channel. They said the reveal of clean metal beneath the dirt was satisfying, and locals began recommending signs for them to tackle.
alt_text: Two raccoons clean a road sign at night while one films with a camera on a tripod.

title: The alligator's final game
caption: He had won the sweepstakes, but the alligator played through the tutorial first.
blurb: Microsoft built a single functioning Xbox Series X inside a five-foot animatronic alligator to promote a sweepstakes. The creature was constructed by John Nolan Studio and designed to hold game discs in its mouth.
alt_text: A man inserts a game disc into the mouth of a motionless animatronic alligator; the alligator's eyes glow red.

title: Peacock bathroom critic
caption: He had a few notes on the lighting.
blurb: A peacock named Hex escaped his enclosure and broke into a home in Queensland, Australia. He was found admiring his reflection in the bathroom mirror, prompting a social-media search before being reunited with his peahen.
alt_text: A peacock standing on a bathroom sink gestures at his reflection with a raised wing, while a man in a bathrobe peers around the door.

title: Alligator at the counter
caption: He had not ordered the everything bagel.
blurb: A three-foot alligator entered a bagel shop in Southport, North Carolina, through the back door. A customer grabbed a chair for protection, but police and animal control captured the reptile without incident and relocated it.
alt_text: A small alligator stands at a bagel shop counter on its hind legs, while a man in an apron presses against the wall holding a chair in front of him.

title: Tarantula travel conditions
caption: His connecting flight was delayed.
blurb: Peruvian authorities seized over 3,000 live tarantulas hidden inside dirty socks in suitcases at Lima airport, bound for Germany. Two Germans and a Polish citizen were arrested in what authorities said was a large-scale smuggling operation worth up to 1.5 million euros.
alt_text: Two panels: first, a tarantula with a baggage tag sits curled in a sock; second, it sits alone on an empty conveyor belt with a leg raised as if hailing a ride.

title: Fence post identification
caption: It was the only fence post that had moved in a month.
blurb: A North Carolina farmer spotted what he thought was a fence post lying on the ground until it turned out to be a missing boa constrictor. The snake had escaped a month earlier and was discovered when the farmer got close enough to see it moving.
alt_text: A very long brown boa constrictor lies perfectly straight and still on grass next to a fence, as a farmer in a straw hat reaches toward it with a repair tool.

title: Cow Evades Capture
caption: She had been waiting to see if he would figure out the knot.
blurb: A large cow escaped in Marshfield, Massachusetts and evaded capture for over a full day. Police warned drivers to watch out, and a local man brought his horse and lasso from a couple hours away to try to wrangle the cow back home.
alt_text: A large black-and-white cow stands in a suburban backyard with a lasso looped over one horn, chewing calmly. A man on a horse stares from a fence, holding the other end of the lasso, looking confused.

title: The grape contract
caption: The monkey felt the arrangement was fair.
blurb: At Shanghai Wild Animal Park, a spider monkey named Doudou refuses to eat grapes unless they are peeled first. Actor Nicky Wu visited the park and peeled grapes for the monkey, who responded by stepping on his head.
alt_text: A spider monkey with its foot on a kneeling man's head while the man offers it a peeled grape.

title: Aerial banana delivery
caption: The service was fine, but the menu needed more variety.
blurb: Flooding at the Save the Chimps sanctuary in Florida cut off a 38-year-old chimpanzee named Kaleb. Staff used an emergency drone they had purchased for just such an occasion to air-drop bananas and blankets to him.
alt_text: A chimpanzee on a muddy island watches a drone descending with a bunch of bananas on a string.

title: Invisible tax
caption: They were invisible to radar, and apparently to the naked eye as well.
blurb: Two all-black cows escaped a property in Marshfield, Massachusetts, and evaded police for days, wandering onto a road at night. Police set up a corral with food to lure them back. The dark animals were nearly impossible to spot in the dark.
alt_text: Two panels: first shows a confused police officer on a dark road shining a flashlight at nothing; second shows the same scene with two black cows standing directly in front of him, one holding a sign, completely invisible to the officer.

title: Dietary consultation
caption: The doctor had put her on a strict diet, but she was not ready to say goodbye to the buffet.
blurb: A red-shouldered hawk found in a Virginia driveway was too fat to fly after weeks of eating free-roaming chickens. Wildlife rescuers put the bird on a diet. She weighed nearly double the normal amount.
alt_text: A round hawk sits on a fence post, looking down at a white chicken standing on the grass. A small plate with a single celery stalk sits nearby.

title: Unauthorized entry
caption: The NFL had no rule covering the half-dressed approach.
blurb: A Dallas Cowboys player who was listed as inactive for a game sprinted onto the field in blue sweatpants and a knitted cap after a teammate recovered a fumble. A referee flagged him, and his team was penalized 15 yards for having an unauthorized player on the field.
alt_text: A referee in a striped shirt holds a yellow penalty flag and looks down with a weary expression at a man in baggy blue sweatpants and a knitted cap who is crouched on the grass holding a football jersey, as if caught mid-change.

title: Unwelcome arrival
caption: She had not ordered the moon landing experience.
blurb: A midnight-blue hot air balloon decorated with a crescent moon and stars made an emergency landing in a residential neighborhood in Menifee, California. A resident filmed the balloon slowly descending into an open field behind a home, and everyone aboard was unharmed.
alt_text: A dark hot air balloon with a crescent moon and stars is collapsed in a suburban backyard. An elderly woman in a floral housecoat stands at a sliding glass door holding a slice of toast, staring at the balloon with a flat, annoyed expression.

title: The Bean Push
caption: The problem was not the weight. The problem was that the directions did not say which way.
blurb: An online meme claimed a man was trapped inside Chicago's Bean sculpture, prompting about 250 people to gather at Millennium Park on November 8 to attempt moving the 110-ton structure seven inches to the left. Flyers said moving the Bean would allow rescuers to deliver pickles to the fictional trapped person. Despite sustained chanting and pushing, the sculpture did not move.
alt_text: A large crowd presses against the side of a giant reflective bean-shaped sculpture in a park, straining with effort, while the sculpture remains unmoved.

title: The Pumpkin Buck
caption: The neighborhood had decided it was not going to trick-or-treat that year.
blurb: A young button buck wandered metro Detroit for 10 days with a plastic Halloween jack-o'-lantern stuck over its snout, unable to eat or drink. The Detroit Animal Welfare Group tracked the deer, crossed a freezing river four times, tranquilized it, and removed the pumpkin. The deer was treated for moderate dehydration and released with an ear tag warning hunters.
alt_text: A small deer stands in a snowy yard with an orange plastic jack-o'-lantern completely over its head, while a squirrel on hind legs stares at it with curiosity from a nearby bird feeder.

title: The Zigzag Corgi
caption: The defense had clearly not watched the tape.
blurb: During a halftime corgi race at a Carolina Panthers vs. Denver Broncos game on November 8, one corgi wearing a blue sweater refused to follow the course and instead zigzagged across the field, evading roughly half a dozen security guards. The crowd erupted in laughter as the small dog turned the chase into a spectacle. Videos of the incident went viral online.
alt_text: A small corgi in a blue sweater stands on a football field, looking back with a flat expression at three security guards lying sprawled on the grass after failing to catch it.

title: Blind Hippos
caption: The strategy was simple: hit everything and hope.
blurb: David Rush and his 7-year-old son Peter set a Guinness World Record on November 8 for the fastest time clearing a game of Hungry Hungry Hippos while blindfolded as a team of two. The father-son duo completed the feat in 7.03 seconds, beating the 20-second goal. Rush said the mental challenge of not knowing when marbles were coming was the hardest part.
alt_text: A man and a child sit on the floor on opposite sides of a Hungry Hungry Hippos game, both wearing black blindfolds, each with a hand on a hippo lever as marbles scatter across the floor.

title: An Honest Mistake
caption: It was not his color, but he did not want to hurt the family's feelings.
blurb: A young buck in Michigan spent ten days with a plastic Halloween pumpkin bucket stuck over its head, unable to eat or drink. Rescuers from the Detroit Animal Welfare Group tracked it to a park, waded a freezing river four times, and tranquilized the deer to remove the bucket. The deer recovered and was released.
alt_text: A deer wearing a bright orange plastic pumpkin bucket on its head stands in a snowy field, while another deer looks at it with a flat expression.

title: Fundraising Hangover
caption: The fame was nice, but the new sobriety was brutal.
blurb: A raccoon broke into a Virginia liquor store last Black Friday, smashed 14 bottles of spirits, and was found passed out on the bathroom floor. A merchandise campaign inspired by the incident raised $250,000 for Hanover County Animal Control. The funds paid for body cameras, new housing, a food shed and a pet pantry.
alt_text: A raccoon lies on its back in a small animal shelter cell, one paw on its forehead, looking hungover, wearing a small T-shirt.

title: Queens' Quarrel
caption: The zoo had failed to specify which colony was which.
blurb: The Phoenix Zoo opened a new habitat for 24 naked mole rats, with two reigning queens each ruling her own colony. The nearly hairless, buck-toothed rodents live in eusocial colonies similar to bees and ants. The zoo president joked it was the first time they had proudly announced the arrival of an entire nudist colony.
alt_text: Two naked mole rats sit side by side in a glass habitat, both wearing tiny jeweled crowns, one frowning at the other.

title: Rethinking Priorities
caption: "I think I should be the one cooking for you."
blurb: A Mumbai resident shared online that his household cook earns ₹1.05 lakh (about $1,260) per month and was planning a vacation to Thailand. The revelation sparked debate in India about what income qualifies as wealthy, with many noting the cook's salary exceeds the take-home pay of many white-collar professionals.
alt_text: A man sits at a kitchen table staring at a spreadsheet, while a cook across from him shows him her smartphone with a polite expression.
